name: Volunteering Matters Action Earth (Scotland)
summary: Micro-grants for volunteer-led projects creating or improving wildlife habitat in urban green spaces in Scotland, such as meadows, ponds and woodlands. Projects need at least 15 volunteers.

status.quote: The programme is now open for 2026 applications, offering grants to help urban communities improve their local environment.

applicant_types.quote: We prioritise applications from volunteer groups that do any of the following:

geography.quote: The project must involve practical outdoor activity by volunteers in Scotland.

access.quote: The programme is now open for 2026 applications, offering grants to help urban communities improve their local environment.

amount.quote: Action Earth provides grants of up to £250 for volunteer-led projects in towns, cities and built-up areas.

administered_by.quote: Delivered by Volunteering Matters and supported by the National Lottery Community Fund, Action Earth provides grants of up to £250
